Name: Rhubarb is a Vegetable
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
I was glancing through some mods earlier and I saw one that [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4520]changes tomatoes[/url] along with a few other things to their 'scientifically' correct category - a comment mentioned that Rhubarb was not a fruit and lo and behold... it's not. So now it's a vegetable. 

Note: If you use Better Artisan Good Icons this makes the Rhubarb's icons not show up ): sorry. I can't do anything about that.

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Rhubarb is a Vegetable
Manifest.Description: Makes Rhubarb appear as a vegetable rather than a fruit cause that's what it is.
